Auto Generator Pro 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Generate finished videos from raw MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM footage (up to 500MB) with automatic AI editing via cloud GPUs.
- Simple onboarding: obtains a session token and sets up a project for each user.
- Supports video upload, state tracking, credits checking, and fast 1080p MP4 export.
- Intelligent prompt routing: detects intent to determine the correct workflow (generate, upload, export, check status, etc).
- Full error handling (token issues, file types, limits, and rate limiting) with user-friendly feedback.
- Stay informed with progress updates and timeline previews during video generation.
